name: UNIC Technology Corp.
summary: UNIC Technology Corp., established in 1991 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the trading of plastic materials. The company's diverse product portfolio features bio-based and conventional plastic materials, alongside advanced rapid self-heating and cooling mold tooling solutions. These offerings are vital for a broad spectrum of applications, including consumer electronics such as LCD televisions, monitors, mobile phones, chargers, adapters, connectors, notebook computers, and office automation equipment. They also serve household appliances, backlight units, motor components, and various molded products like bottles, films, and food packaging. Furthermore, UNIC Technology Corp. distributes environmentally friendly materials, engineering plastics, electronic components, and automotive parts.
